summary: Comprehensive testing of Drag & Drop feature for German Meal Planner (Speiseplaner). All drag & drop functionality works correctly: move to empty slot, swap between filled slots, side dishes move with main recipe, persistence after save and reload.

issues: Console warning: Duplicate React keys for recipe_60cd2e8afad0 - occurs when same recipe is used as side dish multiple times. Minor issue, doesn't affect functionality.
Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed

passed_tests: Filled meal slots have draggable=true attribute
Filled meal slots display GripVertical drag handle icon
Empty meal slots are valid drop targets (not draggable)
Dragging meal to empty slot moves it (source becomes empty, target gets meal)
Toast message 'Gericht verschoben' appears after move operation
Dragging meal to filled slot swaps the two meals
Toast message 'Gerichte getauscht' appears after swap operation
Side dishes (Beilagen) are correctly moved/swapped along with main recipe
Visual feedback: green border on drag-over target (emerald-400 ring)
After drag & drop, clicking 'Speichern' saves the new arrangement
Toast message 'Speiseplan gespeichert' appears after save
After save and page reload, dragged meals remain in new positions
Existing functionality: clicking empty slot opens recipe selection dialog
Existing functionality: clicking meal name opens configure dialog
Existing functionality: clear slot button (X) removes meal from slot
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Duplicate React key warning when same recipe is used as side dish multiple times - consider using unique keys like `${sd.recipe_id}-${index}` in SlotCell component line 425
Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent - add DialogDescription for accessibility

success_rate.backend: 100% (meal plan save/load with drag changes works)

seed_data_creation: Used existing test recipes: recipe_ac29cd0b382a (Spaghetti Carbonara) and recipe_60cd2e8afad0 (Grüner Salat). Test data restored after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Drag & Drop feature is fully implemented and tested using HTML5 native Drag & Drop API. Key components: SlotCell (lines 352-446) handles drag events and visual feedback, handleDragStart/handleDragEnd/handleDragOver/handleDragLeave/handleDrop (lines 549-607) in MealPlanner component. The drag & drop only works on desktop (HTML5 DnD). For mobile, users still use the dialog to manage meals. Test data has 3 meals with side dishes in Mittagessen row (Mon, Tue, Wed) for week 2026-03-23.

drag_drop_feature_details.implementation: HTML5 native Drag & Drop API, no extra dependencies
drag_drop_feature_details.visual_feedback: Green border (emerald-400) on drag-over target, 50% opacity on dragged element
drag_drop_feature_details.side_dishes: Correctly moved/swapped along with main recipe
